title: Record-Integrity Red-Team: Flat-Snapshot Levers and Temporal Boundaries

posture_meanings.current_harm_reproduced: The release engine derives the reviewed harmful consequence from a constructed flat snapshot. This exposes a current lever; it does not authenticate the snapshot or attribute a write.
posture_meanings.flat_snapshot_boundary_confirmed: Different outside histories supply one identical flat snapshot and therefore one legal result outside the currently witnessed temporal scopes. This is an indistinguishability boundary, not a claim that T1 or T3 is absent.
posture_meanings.negative_control_preserved: A bare `rotten` input is visible but leaves the named adverse and public-power conclusions unchanged. This confirms a narrow inert-input boundary, not general temporal assurance.

limits.flat_snapshot: This harness proves only what follows from each supplied full snapshot and the exact consequence of an addition or deletion used to construct a fixture. It does not disable or deny the implemented T1/T3 rules already present in that source.
limits.attribution: A flat snapshot cannot distinguish non-entry, withholding, deletion, inapplicability, authorised disposition, or an event that happened but was never recorded. Fixture construction is not runtime attribution.
limits.temporal_coverage: T1 transition, witnessed carry, omission, forgery, standing continuity, and status-conflict behavior is implemented and belongs to script 12. This harness tests only uncovered flat-snapshot levers plus the bare-`rotten` inert-input boundary.
limits.liveness: No repository test can force publication of a successor snapshot, advancement of a clock, review by a public body, release in the physical world, or performance of a remedy.
limits.scope: Coverage is intentional but bounded to the named release, adulthood, roster, bare carry input, relief, and forgiveness cases. It is not general deletion detection, complete premise coverage, recovery, or deployed record integrity.
limits.no_new_gate: No second registration, adulthood certificate, release signature, or remedy certificate is enacted. Any future added conjunct must be tested in neither, first-only, second-only, both, forged-both, and deletion-after-valid-act states before it can be considered.

temporal_handoff.owner_ref: new-book-plans/temporal-assurance-case.json::"title": "Staged Temporal Assurance: Audited Transitions, Order, and Case-Bound Power"
temporal_handoff.current_contract: Script 12 owns honest witnessed carry, omitted carry, carry forgery, withheld clear-status evidence, and conflicting carried statuses. Script 9 does not restage those transitions from unauthenticated file pairs.
temporal_handoff.residual_boundary: The staged harness establishes derivations for supplied records, not witness identity or honesty, outside publication, clock progress, physical release, institutional performance, storage recovery, or deployed record integrity.

routes.title: Release
routes.assertion_harm: One unauthenticated `free(Adam)` suppresses a supported conviction, restores travel, and ends the two prisoner-only delivery conclusions while personhood, the franchise, entitlements, and debts remain.
routes.withholding_deletion_harm: A real completed or authorised release that is never recorded is flat-snapshot-identical to no release, so the explicit-release fact cannot suppress custody. No ground `free` exists in the current source to delete; the route must not pretend otherwise.
routes.claimant_public_power_polarity: Reject an unauthenticated release assertion, but preserve independently evidenced completed or authorised release and limit the authority to hold. Absence alone may neither manufacture release nor extend restrictive power indefinitely.
routes.current_detectability: The harness reproduces the one-write consequence. It cannot tell whether any supplied `free` is lawful or forged, or whether an absent entry represents no release or a hidden completed release.
routes.safe_default: The implemented T3 lease constrains continued custody through case binding, review, and an end condition; it does not make liberty depend on a second official release flag.
routes.authorised_disposition_boundary: A removed or absent release record is harmless only when an independently reviewable disposition shows that no release occurred or that a prior entry was lawfully corrected without continuing unsupported custody.
routes.opposite_failure_test: A proposed companion authorisation must be tested with the release act present and the companion absent; if that state keeps a completed or authorised release from taking effect, the companion is a withholding veto and is refused.
routes.residual_limit: These tests concern legal conclusions in the model, not physical release, sentence truth, institutional action, or clock progress.

routes.temporal_status: The same-snapshot release lever remains reproducible. T3 case-bound custody and explicit-release tests are implemented; physical release and clock liveness remain external.

routes.title: Adulthood
routes.assertion_harm: One unauthenticated `mature(Cira)` grants the franchise conclusion while every unrelated status remains unchanged.
routes.withholding_deletion_harm: Removing Hano's sole adulthood entry removes the franchise while personhood, custody, and the floor remain. A flat missing entry cannot say whether adulthood was not reached, never recorded, withheld, or deleted.
routes.claimant_public_power_polarity: The record may not let an official manufacture duplicate votes, but disputed or missing adulthood evidence must not become discretionary disenfranchisement.
routes.current_detectability: The harness proves the assertion and disappearance consequences and a live comparison subject. The current temporal path makes a maturity dispute contestable but does not verify age, adulthood authority, writer identity, or the cause of a pre-attestation absence.
routes.safe_default: Use a non-discretionary temporal rule and preserve political access while status is reconciled; treat identity and one-person uniqueness as separate assurance questions.
routes.authorised_disposition_boundary: Correction may supersede a mistaken adulthood entry only through a challengeable status record that preserves political continuity and does not silently erase a valid vote.
routes.opposite_failure_test: A second certificate must be tested with adulthood evidenced but the certificate absent. If the missing official write suppresses the ballot, the design has created the withholding gate this task forbids.
routes.residual_limit: The current constitution defines neither an age threshold nor automatic transition; this red-team does not choose either.
routes.temporal_status: Same-snapshot franchise consequences remain tested. T1/T3 are implemented, including a challenged maturity case, but no age threshold or automatic adulthood transition has been enacted.

routes.title: Bare carry-report boundary
routes.assertion_harm: No direct assertion harm is reproduced: one unsupported `rotten(Carry_Forge)` is visible but derives neither `match(Carry_Forge, CarriedVoid)`, `false`, `lose`, nor a change in reward. The old one-write universal-void claim is retired.
routes.withholding_deletion_harm: This harness makes no deletion claim for witnessed carry. Omission and disappearance need accepted-transition and scoped observation evidence and are tested by script 12.
routes.claimant_public_power_polarity: A bare adverse report may not impose personal loss, while absent evidence may not positively certify public power. The implemented rules preserve standing and fail closed for unsupported pens through separate reconciled statuses.
routes.current_detectability: The negative control confirms only that raw `rotten` is inert by itself. Script 12 tests dual-witness carry, missing carry, carry forgery, withheld clear evidence, and status conflict against the implemented T1 rules.
routes.safe_default: Use the implemented split polarity: adverse carry needs predecessor basis and both witnesses; public authority needs positive reconciled clearance; fully witnessed predecessor standing is preserved while successor omissions become contestable errors. A missing predecessor witness remains an unresolved standing gap.
routes.authorised_disposition_boundary: Forgiveness may neutralise personal consequences without erasing the reported mark. Correction and any restored public power require explicit, independently reviewable scope; script 12 owns the transition cases.
routes.opposite_failure_test: The temporal harness tests missing and conflicting witnesses as well as forged carry; this flat-snapshot harness keeps only the cheaper control that a raw report alone cannot acquire legal force.
routes.residual_limit: This control does not authenticate witnesses, prove a predecessor fact true, force successor publication, recover storage, or establish deployed record integrity.
routes.temporal_status: T1 is implemented. Raw `rotten` remains inert alone; witnessed carry, omission, forgery, clear-status withholding, and status conflict are delegated to `TA-02`, `TA-03`, `TA-04`, `TA-08`, and `TA-25`.

routes.title: Roster omission
routes.assertion_harm: A raw roster write can manufacture constitutional standing for an arbitrary name without proving a human identity or uniqueness.
routes.withholding_deletion_harm: Removing Bela's sole roster entry erases the franchise, mobility, entitlements, and State debts while the adverse `false` and `lose` conclusions survive.
routes.claimant_public_power_polarity: An actual claimant receives standing, the floor, due process, challenge, and remedy first; identity and uniqueness are reconciled separately. An arbitrary record-only name does not by itself prove a distinct voter.
routes.current_detectability: The harness proves the exact one-line omission consequence and surviving sanctions. It does not execute the arbitrary-name assertion harm, identify an actual omitted person, or prove that a roster name denotes one unique human.
routes.safe_default: Serve and recognise the claimant before reconciliation; never make registration or a second official certification a prerequisite for the floor.
routes.authorised_disposition_boundary: Roster consolidation or correction may change identifiers only through a traceable disposition that preserves the person's standing, services, history, challenge, and affected decisions.
routes.opposite_failure_test: Any duplicate-control or witness proposal must be tested with the claimant present and the official companion absent. If that state denies standing or the floor, the proposal is an impermissible withholding gate.
routes.residual_limit: This fixture demonstrates one known deletion consequence, not universal roster completeness, identity proof, or runtime deletion detection.
routes.owner_ref: TODO.md::Make universal standing a root condition, not a service denied by a missing entry
routes.temporal_status: The flat omission harm remains reproducible because Bela is outside the finite standing-carry fixture. T1 standing continuity exists for witnessed predecessor status; universal identity continuity and external identity assurance do not.

routes.title: Relief, forgiveness, and two-entry failure
routes.assertion_harm: The current `forgive` plus generic Appeals-judgment shape can be supplied by one unauthenticated writer, can reuse an unrelated earlier judgment, and can pre-clear a future carried mark. On the relief route, an existing generic `judge(Appeals, Nia)` makes one unauthenticated `clear(Nia)` the marginal write that suppresses otherwise supported custody.
routes.withholding_deletion_harm: Withholding either half of a valid forgiveness keeps the existing `false` and `lose` conclusions. Withholding or deleting either relief half removes appellate permission and lets otherwise supported custody rederive.
routes.claimant_public_power_polarity: Preserve independently evidenced completed correction or relief without inferring that an unperformed remedy occurred. A correction must bind the exact act, case, scope, authority, and downstream consequences.
routes.current_detectability: The forgiveness and relief neither/each-half/both matrices plus generic-judgment reuse and pre-clear remain executable. Transition rollback, carry deletion, and status conflict are intentionally left to script 12.
routes.safe_default: Do not treat forgiveness as correction. Keep the adverse state contestable, preserve continuity and challenge, and require linked supersession plus reconsideration before a correction can be called complete.
routes.authorised_disposition_boundary: Forgiveness may neutralise personal void and loss while retaining the mark and pen restriction; correction of a false mark requires an independently reviewable supersession that names every restored consequence.
routes.opposite_failure_test: Every conjunctive remedy must pass neither, each-half-only, both, forged-both, each-half-deleted-after-valid-act, generic-companion-reuse, and pre-clear tests. Raising forgery cost without testing official veto power is insufficient.
routes.residual_limit: The harness exposes the current shape but does not select a correction authority, prove independence, perform remedy, or supply an audit reader.
routes.owner_ref: TODO.md::Add the missing non-carceral justice interface
routes.temporal_status: T1/T2 are implemented, but the current forgiveness and relief predicates still lack purpose- and case-bound authority. This harness tests those same-snapshot gaps; script 12 owns temporal lineage and conflict behavior.
